title: Great - WHILE IT LASTED!  HELP REQUESTED!
text: Great - WHILE IT LASTED!  HELP REQUESTED!. First, I want to say that this is a beautiful tea light spinner and I enjoyed using it during Christmas and beyond!  I got this a couple of weeks before Christmas and used it everyday.  I switched to the snowflakes and this morning (01-24) it would not spin and I quickly realized that the pointed tip on the rod that holds the spinner was no longer pointed, I don't know if it fell off or just wore down!  I had their All Season Theme spinner in my cart because I was so happy with this one , but will not purchase it now, because of this problem.  Of course, I am just outside of the 30-day return, so I'm stuck.  I would love to hear if anyone has any ideas as to a replacement tip for these spinner rods, as I would really like to fix this and continue using it.  HELP!

product_metadata.title: KOVOT Holiday Metal Spinning Tea Light Holder (All Season Theme) | Includes (1) Holder and (8) Interchangeable Seasonal Spinning Designs
features: FULL HOLIDAY SET - The kit includes all that you need. There’s (1) Tea Light Holder with Fans and (8) Interchangeable Designs. Those include - Snowflakes / Reindeer / USA Flags / Fireworks / Easter Bunnies / Valentines Hearts / Halloween Witches / Thanksgiving Turkey
SPINNING DESIGNS - Hang your chosen design on the fans. Light the candle and great ready for the show. The heat will make the design spin round n’ round. Kids go absolutely crazy for it!
HOLIDAY DECOR - Display the glass enclosure during all of your favorite holidays. It makes a great table centerpiece. And will get you into the spirit!
SAFETY FIRST - The glass controls the heat to keep you safe. However please keep it away from flammable objects. And out of reach of children and pets
JUST THE RIGHT SIZE - Measuring at (7 3/4"H x 4"D) it fits perfectly in your kitchen, living room, or office. Giving the space a bit of holiday cheer. (Note: candle not included)
description: Add some beautiful Holiday decor to your home with the KOVOT Holiday Metal Spinning Tea Light Holder. Set includes: (1) tea light holder + (8) Interchangeable Spinning Designs: Snowflakes / Reindeer / USA Flags / Fireworks / Easter Bunnies / Valentines Hearts / Halloween Witches / Thanksgiving Turkey. Just simply hang the designs you want on the included fans, light the candle and the heat will make it spin. The sleek glass enclosure makes a beautiful holiday centerpiece, is safe and controls the heat to make it spin faster. Keep away from flammable objects, children, and pets. Candle not included. Measures: 7 3/4"H x 4"D
